english.title: Use motor vehicle / trailer - tyre less than 1 mm tread
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely**(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) wheel of the vehicle were not of a depth of at least 1mm throughout a continuous band measuring at least three-quarters of the breadth of the tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(1)(g)(i) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used on a road a motor vehicle / trailer
when the wheel(s) fitted with pneumatic tyre
on which the grooves did not have depth of at least 1mm
throughout a continuous band measuring at least
three-quarters of the breadth of the tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For vehicles which require a minimum tread depth of 1.6mm use charge headings H149, H150 and H151 (i.e. Cars, vans and light trailers etc.)
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - Two hundred pounds.and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
